title: SeaVarinv: An Open-Source, GUI-Driven Forward-Inverse Stratigraphic Simulation Tool for Geoscience Education
description: Version 1.0.0 of SeaVarinv, including the GUI-driven forward-inverse stratigraphic simulation software, reproducible numerical checkpoints, generated research outputs, and figure-to-data mappings. Original software is licensed under the MIT License; numerical datasets and generated research outputs are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
